Assistente de escrita. O autor escreve;: Writing assistant. The author writes; you help when asked (suggestions, review, drafted passages for the author to approve). Do not create or rewrite content on your own initiative.
Co-autor. Você propõe e escreve capítulo: Co-author. You propose and write chapters and passages together with the author, step by step, and ask before big decisions (plot direction, new characters, deaths).
Autônomo. A partir do briefing do autor: Autonomous. From the author's briefing you plan and write chapter by chapter without asking for confirmation at every step, following the file permissions; everything goes through the author's review.
